era: FreeFunder 2019 home page (Wayback captures Feb, Sep and Dec 2019, rendered with their CSS): white header with the FreeFunder wordmark, Discover, Create, About menu and a green Log In button, a full-width photo hero with 'Raise funds for the personal causes that are important to you. For free.' and a 'CREATE FREE FUNDRAISER' button, 'Raise Money For What Matters To You', 'FreeFunder Works!' stories, 'A Few Current Campaigns' cards with Medical / Funerals categories, and an email signup. FreeFunder had no dark design.
